record.description: Prezi is a leading presentation software company that specializes in enhancing visual storytelling through innovative technology. Founded in 2009, it has empowered over 150 million users globally, including students and business leaders, to create visually engaging presentations quickly and effectively with the aid of Prezi AI. With a virtual-first operation and base locations in Budapest and Riga, Prezi serves a diverse clientele across more than 180 countries, making presentations that captivate and inspire.
